programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny
programme.desc: Po and the Kids finally arrive in the Forbidden City. After an assassination scare, Xiao enlists Po and the 4Cs for help protecting her during her father's funeral.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: A bummed out Tina takes a vacation to the baby resort, Floaties! However, her mind is still back at work, and struggled to actually enjoy her vacation. And it gets worse when Crispin Biscuits switches electronic ID tags with her, causing everyone to assume Tina actually is Crispin Biscuits. With Crispin having booked her for a seemingly endless stay, Tina is trapped in a paradise nightmare, and in a tunnel of madness starts to think that she may even be Crispin.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits heists the underwater Baby Bank in an attempt to steal all the funds from Boss and Tina’s new company. Boss, Tina and Banker Baby Benny must infiltrate the bank via submarine to stop this high-stakes aquatic robbery. But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Tony was right; Dann is back and she’s been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: The team realizes they can’t stop Dann on their own, so they call in Ms. Nowhere for backup. While they try to come up with a game plan, Dann ambushes them! In their time of need, they turn to the last person they ever thought they’d ask for help: Cleve Kelso.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When the adults exclude the kids from their adult-only cave, the kids make their own much cooler cave, soon making the adults want to switch caves.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: While Tom struggles with admitting his feelings for Jun, the pair find themselves trapped inside a giant tree with an anxious colony of Woodchipper dragons.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Thunder must wrangle and lead the Hero Dragons in a desperate attempt to save Tom and the riders from a dangerous new dragon, The Glass Caster.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this “Qilin” isn’t an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot “Qilin” and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season 1. While captive, Yi and the crew learn of a higher power known as the Great Watchers, and that Mr. Lung is furious at Yi for unwittingly replacing him as the GW-approved keeper of magical creatures. Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Liam's the prime suspect in an accident that ruins Birch's artwork. Birch rakes her innocent cousin over the coals, while the guilty party stands by allowing him to take the rap until the stakes rise and the comic suddenly more valuable.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: In an effort to raise a few quick bucks for her Mom's birthday present, Birch takes a job in the cafeteria. Every shift sees Birch becoming more officious until critical mass occurs. Filling in for the Lunch Lady, the power goes straight to Birch's head! It takes her podmates to bring her back down to earth and keep her from alienating everyone in school!

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Cosmos' High is putting on a rendition of the Broadway musical “Teenland” and Pod 4 is excited to hit the floorboards. When it becomes apparent that Birch is the only one with a chance at theatrical success, the rest of the pod rally around to “coach” her towards stardom. Unfortunately, Birch is only the understudy to Amelia's full diva.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: To teach them a lesson about rivalry Mr. Towes makes Birch the leader of Amelia's pod and Amelia the leader of Birch's pod. To get back into their own pods they must meet Towes' ultimate challenge and do well in their new pods. The girls soon realize that to make this happen their longstanding rivalry has to give way to at least a little cooperation.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks she's ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: There's a new girl in Olivia's class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia (the original Olivia) can't believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself “Pam,” Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Father takes Olivia and Ian to “bring your kids to work day,” Olivia is looking forward to a fun day with dad at the office. But when Father is given a new deadline for a big project, Olivia hatches a plan to help him out. First, however they have to track down Ian's missing frog.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After learning about the environment, Olivia is on a mission to recycle, cut down on waste, and conserve energy. But she just can't get Ian to turn off his light at night. Either she'll have to find a way for Ian to fall asleep without it, or else find a sustainable alternative

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. programme.title: Team Zenko Go

programme.title: Team Zenko Go

programme.desc: When Grug thinks his forehead looks too big in Ugga's family portrait, she strives to make the painting disappear.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When the adults exclude the kids from their adult-only cave, the kids make their own much cooler cave, soon making the adults want to switch caves.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: While Tom struggles with admitting his feelings for Jun, the pair find themselves trapped inside a giant tree with an anxious colony of Woodchipper dragons.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Thunder must wrangle and lead the Hero Dragons in a desperate attempt to save Tom and the riders from a dangerous new dragon, The Glass Caster.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this “Qilin” isn’t an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot “Qilin” and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season 1. While captive, Yi and the crew learn of a higher power known as the Great Watchers, and that Mr. Lung is furious at Yi for unwittingly replacing him as the GW-approved keeper of magical creatures. Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Liam's the prime suspect in an accident that ruins Birch's artwork. Birch rakes her innocent cousin over the coals, while the guilty party stands by allowing him to take the rap until the stakes rise and the comic suddenly more valuable.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: In an effort to raise a few quick bucks for her Mom's birthday present, Birch takes a job in the cafeteria. Every shift sees Birch becoming more officious until critical mass occurs. Filling in for the Lunch Lady, the power goes straight to Birch's head! It takes her podmates to bring her back down to earth and keep her from alienating everyone in school!

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Cosmos' High is putting on a rendition of the Broadway musical “Teenland” and Pod 4 is excited to hit the floorboards. When it becomes apparent that Birch is the only one with a chance at theatrical success, the rest of the pod rally around to “coach” her towards stardom. Unfortunately, Birch is only the understudy to Amelia's full diva.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: To teach them a lesson about rivalry Mr. Towes makes Birch the leader of Amelia's pod and Amelia the leader of Birch's pod. The girls soon realize that to make this happen their longstanding rivalry has to give way to at least a little cooperation.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks she's ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: There's a new girl in Olivia's class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia (the original Olivia) can't believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself “Pam,” Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After learning about the environment, Olivia is on a mission to recycle, cut down on waste, and conserve energy. But she just can't get Ian to turn off his light at night. Either she'll have to find a way for Ian to fall asleep without it, or else find a sustainable alternative

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries

programme.title: Team Zenko Go

programme.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programme.desc: Rachael prepares a popular Tuscan dish of red wine-infused beef stew served with creamy polenta.

programme.title: Global Soul Kitchen (S2)

programme.title: A Nurse To Die For
programme.desc: A father hires a live-in nurse to help care for his sick daughter, however, as she suffers a series of setbacks, he starts to wonder if the nurse might actually be the one keeping her sick.

programme.title: The Face I Can't Forget
programme.desc: After waking from a car accident with total amnesia, Mia is taken home to be cared for by her loving husband and daughter. But as she recuperates, Mia has flashbacks of a second daughter.

programme.title: Got To Leave Something
programme.desc: The journey heads towards the picturesque water city of Chuncheon. Nam-gil and Sang-yoon meet a travelling doctor who works in remote villages without medical facilities and join him on his rounds.

programme.title: Airline Wars

programme.title: 1,000 Ways to Dine

programme.desc: As Knockout Week continues, the MasterChef judges have each filled a fridge with ingredients. Eight contestants must choose a fridge, without looking inside, and use its contents to make a dish.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)
programme.desc: It’s Knockout Week and the first elimination for the top ten. To keep their place in the competition, the seven contestants' cooking must feature an ingredient chosen by one of their fellow cooks.

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)

programme.title: MasterChef Australia (S18)
programme.desc: In an elimination cook-off, contestants must produce a dish featuring one of five internationally sourced ingredients that they have never used before. For one cook, it will be their final dish.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Mcdonald's - Le Recap (1/2)
programme.desc: Match summaries, commentary and analyses, after each day of the Ligue 1 McDonald's, the French football championship.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Mcdonald's - Le Recap (2/2)
programme.desc: Match summaries, commentary and analyses, after each day of the Ligue 1 McDonald's, the French football championship.

programme.title: Colombine
programme.desc: Colombine, 13 years old, is in conflict with her mother. On the run, she travels through time in search of her absent father. She is parachuted one year earlier to the Fete des Vignerons. Alone in the world of adults, Colombine tries to find traces of her father.

programme.title: Si On A La Nuit
programme.desc: Near the Pont Neuf in Paris, Camille sells books and Paul models of the Eiffel Tower. Their meeting was pure chance, their journey through the night inevitable.

programme.title: Pieges
programme.desc: The prisoners' plan fails. One by one they have to confront their worst fears, under the amused gaze of their persecutor. Dissension reigns, but when Alain collapses, they still attempt a second escape.

programme.title: Pieges
programme.desc: The Cat increases the psychological pressure on the prisoners. They now have to fight their common enemy whilst also keeping their own secrets safe. Finally, their jailer commits a fatal error.

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.desc: What's new in the Arab worlds? Journalist Mohamed Kaci hosts those making the cultural headlines in Tunis, Algiers, Rabat, Beirut, Alexandria, Dubai...

programme.desc: TV5MONDE's major daily news programme, decrypting the news! What you need to know: the Francophone view of the day's main events. programme.title: L'Invite
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin hosts the stars in the headlines, culture, music, film, books, an unmissable rendezvous with all those who light up our times.

programme.title: Au Bout De L'Enquete, La Fin Du Crime Parfait ?
programme.desc: They are all cases that were closed, considered unsolvable, sometimes resisting police efforts for decades until a forgotten clue, an unhoped-for witness or a forensic innovation finally made it possible to unmask the culprit. Alongside Marie Drucker, the criminologist Alain Bauer explains the technical, psychological, sociological or historical elements involved.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rtbf

programme.title: Tendance XXI
programme.desc: A stroll along Rue du Bac in Paris, where tradition and innovation come together with elegance. Pierres d'Histoire showcases historic residences by transforming them into holiday retreats. Dominique Imbert and Isabelle Bettan are behind this project. All about the Paris-Brest pastry. The washed look is reinventing itself on the catwalks.

programme.title: Secrets Des Profondeurs
programme.desc: Sam and Mario visit the Great Lakes, scene of a tragic maritime disaster over a century ago. A dramatic storm caused a large number of ships to founder with innumerable lives lost.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
